svg.title: B13 GAIA PIXELSCOUT — Ecological Instance Mapping engineering architecture
svg.desc: The diagram separates annotation types, mask matching and ecological error correction. Its outputs represent supported visible crown instances, with calibration uncertainty and an explicit boundary on transfer to unfamiliar habitats.
